message: Physics + residual ML stays at or below recalibrated Stefan from 25 labels upward, recovers in a new region with 25 target labels, and in external CALM regions 5 local labels cut the error to the level of recalibrated Stefan.
medium: Scientific Reports, double column, 180 mm wide, fixed canvas
style: same tokens as Fig. 3 (fig34_common.py); 95% interval band = solid light tint of #D55E00; product reference lines grey (ESA CCI v5 dashed, Wei 2026 / Liu 2024 dotted)
layout: row 1: a (3 region panels, widths proportional to the number of label categories); row 2: b (3 region panels) | c (one panel, reference labels at the right end). One method legend at the top.
